title: The Choir of Caerlum
author: Odile Hartwell
blurb: Dominic Ravensworth, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
